def is_fast_forward(main_tip, feature_tip):
    cur = feature_tip
    while cur is not None:
        if cur == main_tip:
            return True
        cur = commits[cur]['parent']
    return False

def ancestors(tip):
    seen = []
    cur = tip
    while cur is not None:
        seen.append(cur)
        cur = commits[cur]['parent']
    return seen

def lint_subject(subject):
    words = subject.split()
    if len(subject) > 50:
        return 'too long'
    if words[0].lower() not in ['add', 'fix', 'refactor', 'update', 'remove', 'feat']:
        return 'not imperative'
    return 'ok'

# ملعبك الحرّ — نموذج Git المصغّر بين يديك
# Your playground — the Mini-Git model in your hands

class MiniGit:
    def __init__(self):
        self.commits = {}
        self.branches = {'main': None}
        self.head = 'main'
        self.files = {}
        self.next_id = 1

    def change(self, fname, version):
        self.files[fname] = version

    def commit(self, msg):
        cid = 'c%d' % self.next_id
        self.next_id = self.next_id + 1
        self.commits[cid] = {'id': cid, 'parent': self.branches[self.head], 'msg': msg, 'files': dict(self.files)}
        self.branches[self.head] = cid
        return cid

    def branch(self, name):
        self.branches[name] = self.branches[self.head]

    def checkout(self, name):
        self.head = name
        tip = self.branches[name]
        if tip is not None:
            self.files = dict(self.commits[tip]['files'])


g = MiniGit()
g.change('app.py', 'v1')
print(g.commit('Add app'))
